recognize_zh: 中央一顆小至中型淋巴球，細胞核深染且布滿交錯溝紋，呈腦迴狀（cerebriform），胞質很少；左下角另一顆細胞核折疊呈分葉狀，上方的分葉中性球可作為對照，符合 Sézary 細胞。
features: Central lymphoid cell slightly larger than a red cell with a convoluted, cerebriform nucleus
Dense, hyperchromatic chromatin with fine grooves and no visible nucleoli
Second atypical cell at lower left with a folded, lobulated nucleus
Segmented neutrophil at top for comparison; normochromic red cells with occasional target cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows atypical lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and convoluted, cerebriform nuclei with dense chromatin and fine grooves; nucleoli are not seen. A second atypical cell with a folded, lobulated nucleus is present at the lower left, and a normal segmented neutrophil is seen at the top. Red cells are normochromic with occasional target forms. Findings are consistent with circulating Sezary cells.

ddx.vs: ATLL cells show deeply polylobated flower-like nuclei and are associated with HTLV-1 and hypercalcemia.
T-PLL cells have a prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic protrusions with TCL1 rearrangement.
Neutrophils have granular pink cytoplasm and discrete lobes joined by filaments rather than a grooved single nucleus with scant agranular cytoplasm.
